title: What’s the hardest part about trusting God lately?
paragraphs:
What’s the hardest part about trusting God lately?
And don’t say “nothing,” because I know you’ve had at least ONE moment where you looked at Heaven like:
“Umm… God? You still working on my case or nah?” 😂🙏

Be honest—
Is it the waiting?
The not-knowing?
The “Why is this taking 27 years?” part?
The “God, PLEASE give me a sign” phase?
Or the “I think I just made it worse” moment? 😭🔥

Someone out there needs to know they’re not the only one wrestling with trust today.
👇👇👇
Let’s talk about it.
